title: Inspection, Extraction and Surface Treatment Prices (Water Damage Mitigation)
content:
This Water Damage Mitigation price list extract gives, for each of the six tiers, the once-per-job inspection fees, the per-square-foot rates for water extraction, antimicrobial application and HEPA vacuuming, and whether antimicrobial treatment is required on the tier.

| Tier | Moisture mapping (each) | Thermal imaging (each) | Extraction per sq ft | Antimicrobial per sq ft | Antimicrobial required | HEPA vacuuming per sq ft |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Clean Water Mitigation - Standard Loss | $145.00 | $95.00 | $0.62 | $0.36 | No | $0.31 |
| Clean Water Mitigation - Large Loss | $245.00 | $165.00 | $0.56 | $0.32 | No | $0.28 |
| Gray Water Mitigation - Standard Loss | $145.00 | $95.00 | $0.78 | $0.36 | Yes | $0.31 |
| Gray Water Mitigation - Large Loss | $245.00 | $165.00 | $0.70 | $0.32 | Yes | $0.28 |
| Black Water Mitigation - Standard Loss | $145.00 | $95.00 | $0.94 | $0.41 | Yes | $0.52 |
| Black Water Mitigation - Large Loss | $245.00 | $165.00 | $0.85 | $0.37 | Yes | $0.47 |

## Price list definitions
- **Moisture mapping**: Initial moisture mapping and documentation fee, once per job, USD.
- **Thermal imaging**: Infrared thermal imaging inspection fee, once per job, USD.
- **Extraction**: Water extraction from flooring per square foot, USD.
- **Antimicrobial**: Antimicrobial application per square foot, USD.
- **Antimicrobial required**: Whether antimicrobial treatment of affected surfaces is required (and billable), boolean.
- **HEPA vacuuming**: HEPA vacuuming of affected surfaces per square foot, USD.

## Notes
- Moisture mapping and thermal imaging are priced by size of loss only: every Standard Loss tier carries one pair of fees and every Large Loss tier another.
- Antimicrobial treatment is required on the Gray Water Mitigation and Black Water Mitigation tiers and is not required on the two Clean Water Mitigation tiers, although those tiers still list an antimicrobial rate.
